free_text: Deferring biopsy is recommended because the mpMRI was inconclusive with a PI-RADS NA score and no PI-RADS 3+ lesion identified. Although the PSA velocity is rising (0.6 ng/mL/yr) and the csPCa predicted probability is high (0.529), the lack of a definitive high-risk lesion on imaging argues against immediate sampling. The decision is borderline as the rising PSA trend conflicts with the negative imaging findings, leading to a deferral based on the principle of not sampling when imaging is negative.
